# ui::Utf8Decoded

Header: `winui/core/Utf8.hpp`.

One decoded code point and the number of bytes it took, as returned by [decode_utf8()](namespace-ui.md#decode_utf8).

Example: 
```cpp
const std::string text = "a\xC3\xA4"; // "a" then U+00E4

// A dump of the code points for a log, stepping by each one's length in bytes.
std::string dump;
for (std::size_t pos = 0; pos < text.size();)
{
    const ui::Utf8Decoded d = ui::decode_utf8(text, pos); // length 1 for "a", 2 for U+00E4
    dump += std::format("U+{:04X} ", static_cast<std::uint32_t>(d.code_point));
    pos += d.length;
}
// dump == "U+0061 U+00E4 "
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code_point` | `char32_t` | `0` | the decoded code point; U+FFFD for a malformed sequence |
| `length` | `std::size_t` | `0` | at least 1 unless `pos` was at the end |
